verdict.rationale: Pipedream's docs say it provides official TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs for its Connect service. They include SDK code samples (pd.proxy.post), a projectEnvironment option in the SDK, and an SDK migration guide that commits to not deprecating the 1.x TypeScript SDK. Missing for 10: documented SDK coverage beyond the Connect surface (e.g. the workflows/REST product), independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Pipedream provides TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs along with a REST API to interact with the Connect service.
SDKs to handle user authentication for 3,000+ APIs
there are no plans to deprecate the `1.x` TypeScript SDK, so if you've already implemented that version, make sure to read through the migration guide
